preview: In this episode, we look at how digital tip screens frame a payment decision. The question is whether a suggested amount simply records what customers want or changes the choice in front of them. This matters because a small screen can affect an everyday decision. By the end, you will understand what the research can tell us about how these screens shape a tip decision.
comment_1: Listen for what the taxi study found about the first tip number shown on the screen.
comment_2: So far, we have seen that the first suggested number can change the tip a customer leaves. But what happens when that number feels too high?
comment_3: This story shows that a tip screen can do more than record your choice. It can guide the choice, especially when it shows a suggested amount first. Next, we will look at two other perspectives on this change.
comment_4: Tipping has changed over time, and the screen can make the choice feel less private. At the same time, the survey suggests that some people are starting to push back. Now, let’s bring these points together.
